images.description: A developer leaning back with hands behind their head, talking to a glowing orb while a small robot works at the laptop
images.prompt: Flat design, minimalist illustration, soft pastel colors, clean lines, white background, warm color palette. A relaxed developer leaning back in a desk chair with hands behind their head, a small speech bubble coming from their mouth. Next to the desk floats a softly glowing round orb made of tiny dots, with a matching speech bubble. At the laptop on the desk, a small friendly robot types on the keyboard. Calm, slightly funny mood: the human is doing nothing with their hands while work gets done.

images.description: An orb talking into a speaker while the microphone next to it picks up the same words, in an infinite loop
images.prompt: Flat design, minimalist illustration, soft pastel colors, clean lines, white background, warm color palette. A small glowing dot-orb character speaking, its sound waves coming out of a laptop speaker, curving around and flowing straight back into a microphone right next to it, forming a circular loop arrow. The orb looks mildly confused, as if it is answering itself. Simple, humorous diagram of an audio echo loop.
